g.text: V19 full mission vs V20 prefix9: different terminal policy
Region 9: V19 timed out at 90.165 s (104 pre-arrival resets); V20 arrived in 23.625 s (0 pre-arrival resets).
V20 ends and parks at region 9; V19 was intended to continue. These are observed runs, not a matched terminal-policy experiment.
Sources: bound compact PID/SLAM series only. No interpolation or fabricated samples. Limited prefix9 PASS; full46 and all 200 Hz physics remain unverified.
